summary: A drum machine for glitch and microsound beats in which every sound is synthesized, with polymetric sequencing, mutating loops and stutter effects on the keys. Beta, tested on one unit.
features: 27 slots, one per key: a hi-hat plus 26 synthesized microsounds
Up to 64 steps per slot with own length, rate, probability, ratchets
Random beat generator and MUTATE for loops that change each bar
16 stutter and 11 punch-in effects, held with FX and a key
Tape echo, delay, filter with drive and shimmer reverb
16 stored patterns; MIDI notes, clock, start and stop

headings: glitch – microsound drum machine for the m-vave fm-1
